" alt="地点卡片内显示相关站外攻略" loading="lazy"><span class="shot-label">关联旅行攻略</span></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="content-process"><div><span>01</span><strong>收藏地点</strong></div><i></i><div><span>02</span><strong>添加影像与笔记</strong></div><i></i><div><span>03</span><strong>关联攻略</strong></div><i></i><div><span>04</span><strong>点击查看原文</strong></div></div>
      <div class="external-demo"><div class="external-heading"><h3>真实的站外内容联动</h3><p>录屏中展示了哔哩哔哩和小红书，点击关联攻略后跳转查看，不把外部内容伪装成产品自带内容。</p></div><div class="external-gallery"><div><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="从 Footprint Map 打开的真实小红书内容" loading="lazy"><span>小红书 · 旅行笔记</span></div><div><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="从 Footprint Map 打开的真实哔哩哔哩旅行视频" loading="lazy"><span>哔哩哔哩 · 旅行视频</span></div></div></div>
    </section>

    <section class="page content-page" data-page="route" aria-labelledby="route-title">
      <div class="chapter-top"><div class="chapter-number">05 — ROUTE TO REAL WORLD</div><h2 id="route-title">从想去的地方，到真正出发。</h2><p>路线不仅是一条线。点位详情、路段气泡与导航选择都在其中。</p></div>
      <div class="route-gallery">
        <div class="route-shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实路线站点编排界面" loading="lazy"><div><span>01</span> 选择与排序</div></div>
        <div class="route-shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实路线连线与地图" loading="lazy"><div><span>02</span> 地图与连线</div></div>
        <div class="route-shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实星标点开详细卡片" loading="lazy"><div><span>03</span> 点击星标看详情*</div></div>
        <div class="route-shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实地图路线分段气泡" loading="lazy"><div><span>04</span> 路段气泡</div></div>
        <div class="route-shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实选择导航软件界面" loading="lazy"><div><span>05</span> 选择导航方式</div></div>
        <div class="route-shot"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="真实跳转到 Apple 地图路线页面" loading="lazy"><div><span>06</span> Apple 地图</div></div>
      </div>
      <p class="fineprint">* 录屏中“点星标展开详情”镜头来自普通收藏地图，而非路线地图中的连续点击；本展示如实保留镜头来源，不把剪辑误称为同一段操作。</p>
      <div class="route-last"><strong>地图不止记录旅行。</strong><span>它也可以成为下一段旅程的起点。</span></div>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer class="footer"><div class="foot-brand">Footprint Map <span>· 产品设计与发布</span></div><div class="foot-right"><span id="page-counter">01 / 06</span><button type="button" id="prev-page" aria-label="上一章">←</button><button type="button" id="next-page" aria-label="下一章">→</button></div></footer>
</div>
<script>
const iconDataMap={"14_edit":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","20_more":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","15_share":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","27_visited":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","30_copy":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","24_town":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","12_video":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","55_parking":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","44_stay":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","50_school":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","13_add_media":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","active_03_star":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","03_star":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","46_park":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","05_footprints":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","23_forest":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","31_checkin":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","40_direction":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","01_map":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","42_fit":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","34_details":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","54_bank":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","35_back":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","52_library":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","21_mountain":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","06_profile":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","45_museum":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","39_save_note":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","29_open_link":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","33_filter":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","11_camera":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","53_pharmacy":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","56_sport":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","47_coffee":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","18_locate":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","19_close":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","08_photo_video":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","37_pause":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","28_upload":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","48_transit":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","10_nearby":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","16_add_place":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","active_04_star_saved":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","58_worship":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","36_photo_count":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","04_star_saved":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","09_guides":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","26_lake":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","32_add_guide":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","49_shopping":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","43_food":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","22_sea":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","38_remove_media":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","57_civic":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","51_hospital":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","02_search":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","41_star_plan":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","07_brief":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","25_creative":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","17_route":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,"};
'use strict';
const pages=['home','origin','map','system','content','route'];
let active='home';
const chapters={home:'01',origin:'02',map:'03',system:'04',content:'05',route:'06'};
function go(page,{push=true}={}){
  if(!pages.includes(page))page='home';
  active=page;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]').forEach(el=>{el.classList.toggle('active',el.dataset.page===page);el.hidden=el.dataset.page!==page;});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(el=>{const a=el.dataset.nav===page;el.classList.toggle('active',a);el.setAttribute('aria-current',a?'page':'false');});
  document.getElementById('page-counter').textContent=`${chapters[page]} / 06`;
  document.querySelector('.nav').classList.remove('open');document.getElementById('nav-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
  document.title=`${page==='home'?'产品发布':({origin:'产品缘起',map:'地图与原版图标',system:'视觉细节',content:'地点内容',route:'路线与出发'})[page]} · Footprint Map`;
  if(push && location.hash!==`#/${page}`)location.hash=`#/${page}`;
  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});
  const video=document.getElementById('launch-video');if(page!=='home'&&!video.paused)video.pause();
}
function hashPage(){return location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/,'').split('?')[0]||'home'}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>go(hashPage(),{push:false}));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-nav]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>go(b.dataset.nav)));
document.getElementById('prev-page').addEventListener('click',()=>go(pages[Math.max(pages.indexOf(active)-1,0)]));
document.getElementById('next-page').addEventListener('click',()=>go(pages[Math.min(pages.indexOf(active)+1,pages.length-1)]));
document.getElementById('nav-toggle').addEventListener('click',e=>{const n=document.querySelector('.nav');n.classList.toggle('open');e.currentTarget.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(n.classList.contains('open')))});
document.getElementById('watch-video').addEventListener('click',()=>{const v=document.getElementById('launch-video');v.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});v.play().catch(()=>{})});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['INPUT','TEXTAREA'].includes(e.target.tagName))return;if(e.key==='ArrowRight')go(pages[Math.min(pages.indexOf(active)+1,5)]);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')go(pages[Math.max(pages.indexOf(active)-1,0)])});

// All icon files are taken verbatim from the original product SVG bundle, not recreated images.
const iconNames={
  '01_map':'地图','02_search':'搜索','03_star':'收藏星标','04_star_saved':'已收藏','05_footprints':'足迹','06_profile':'个人','07_brief':'记录','08_photo_video':'影像','09_guides':'旅行攻略','10_nearby':'附近','11_camera':'相机','12_video':'视频','13_add_media':'添加影像','14_edit':'编辑','15_share':'分享','16_add_place':'添加地点','17_route':'路线','18_locate':'定位','19_close':'关闭','20_more':'更多',
  '21_mountain':'山景','22_sea':'海景','23_forest':'森林','24_town':'城镇','25_creative':'文创','26_lake':'湖泊',
  '27_visited':'已到访','28_upload':'上传','29_open_link':'打开链接','30_copy':'复制','31_checkin':'打卡','32_add_guide':'添加攻略','33_filter':'筛选','34_details':'详情','35_back':'返回','36_photo_count':'影像数量','37_pause':'暂停','38_remove_media':'删除影像','39_save_note':'保存记录','40_direction':'方向','41_star_plan':'想去星标','42_fit':'适配地图',
  '43_food':'餐饮','44_stay':'住宿','45_museum':'博物馆','46_park':'公园','47_coffee':'咖啡','48_transit':'交通','49_shopping':'购物','50_school':'学校','51_hospital':'医院','52_library':'图书馆','53_pharmacy':'药店','54_bank':'银行','55_parking':'停车','56_sport':'运动','57_civic':'公共服务','58_worship':'宗教场所',
  'active_03_star':'星标激活态','active_04_star_saved':'已收藏激活态'
};
const poiIds=new Set(['21_mountain','22_sea','23_forest','24_town','25_creative','26_lake','43_food','44_stay','45_museum','46_park','47_coffee','48_transit','49_shopping','50_school','51_hospital','52_library','53_pharmacy','54_bank','55_parking','56_sport','57_civic','58_worship']);
let filter='poi';
function renderIcons(){const container=document.getElementById('icon-gallery');let ids=Object.keys(iconNames).filter(k=>filter==='all'||(filter==='poi'?poiIds.has(k):!poiIds.has(k)));container.replaceChildren();for(const id of ids){const tile=document.createElement('div');tile.className='icon-tile';tile.title=`源文件：${id}.svg`;const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=iconDataMap[id];img.alt=`Footprint Map 原版图标：${iconNames[id]}`;img.loading='lazy';const title=document.createElement('span');title.textContent=iconNames[id];const code=document.createElement('small');code.textContent=id.startsWith('active')?'状态变体':id.slice(0,2);tile.append(img,title,code);container.append(tile);}document.getElementById('icon-result-count').textContent=`显示 ${ids.length} 个原始素材`;}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>{filter=el.dataset.filter;document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b===el));renderIcons();}));
renderIcons();go(hashPage(),{push:false});

</script>
</body>
</html>
